snippet.title: Formula Legends - Late20' New Season and Free Content Updates
snippet.description:
Formula Legends – Late 2020s Season & Free Content Update

A massive new update has arrived for Formula Legends, bringing brand-new cars, championships and track content.

Late 2020s Car – Season Pack (Paid DLC)
Includes 7 teams, 14 drivers and the new Azerbajan City Circuit.
Drive a modern open-wheel racer inspired by cutting-edge technology: manage battery charge, deploy boost strategically and switch between low-downforce (A Mode) and high-downforce (B Mode). Available in Time Trial and Custom modes.

Free Content Update
The update also introduces a Late 1950s car and championship, letting players experience the origins of open-wheel racing with era-specific teams and drivers.

Temple of Speed – Vintage Configuration
A classic version of the legendary high-speed circuit featuring massive banked corners and the raw challenge of vintage racing.

The update also includes a free Late 2020s team for all players.

More features and content are coming soon as Formula Legends continues to evolve.

Let us know what you think in the comments 👇

Formula Legends 🚥 Out Now on:
🎮 PC (Steam) https://store.steampowered.com/app/31...
🎮 Epic Store - https://store.epicgames.com/it/p/form...
🎮 GOG - https://www.gog.com/en/game/formula_l...
🎮 PlayStation 4/5 - https://store.playstation.com/it-it/c...
🎮 Xbox Series X|S - https://www.xbox.com/it-IT/games/stor...
🎮 Nintendo Switch - https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/...
